nai.positive: realistic, photorealistic, dark fantasy, gritty, desaturated, film grain, dramatic lighting, detailed skin texture
nai.negative: anime, cartoon, cel shading, lineart, chibi

gpt.style: Grim, near-photographic dark-fantasy realism: desaturated earthy palette, torch or overcast light, weathered materials with grime and wear, shallow depth of field, like a still from a prestige fantasy film.
gpt.avoid: Avoid anime or cartoon styling, clean digital gloss and bright saturated colour.
